source_cohort.provider: Databento GLBX.MDP3 reconstructed CME legacy FIX/FAST MDP2

official_documentation.finding: NYMEX Chapter 220.102.F: termination on the third exchange business day before delivery; originally listed expiry is retained if official holiday calendar later changes, except when that expiry itself becomes a holiday

CME historically changed an exchange-business-day determination for December 31, 2010, showing why a generic weekday or federal holiday calendar does not independently establish listed NG contract expiry
CME FIX tag 5796 TradingReferenceDate becomes ts_ref; MDP2 ts_recv is not an independently measured capture clock; multiple statistic messages may include preliminary and final values
2025-07-25 update mentions missing reference fixes for 2015-11-20 to 2017-05-21 and pre-2017 statistic ordering; 2025-09-23 specifically fixes settlement ts_ref before 2015, not type6/9
CME publishes preliminary and final daily bulletins on distinct following-business-day schedules
CME retired old bulletin/settlement FTP delivery in January 2024 and moved settlement files to DataMine

requirements_before_promoting_any_unrefe: Access independently dated CME or provider-authoritative daily final bulletin or exchange-native trading reference for each contract/session without inferring date from ts_event or ts_recv
Match official NG futures venue, contract expiration, time-valid symbol, year-specific instrument identity and source quantity for stat types 6 and 9
Reconcile published/preliminary/final revisions and verify availability strictly before each model decision
Reconcile 3204 exceptions separately, including 1870 same-clock conflicts, 1144 annual-only no-prior and 190 publication-lag outliers
Preserve original source bytes and SHA-256 evidence, versioned exclusions and no fabricated timestamps
Retain 2010-2014 sparse official open interest/cleared volume when independently dated facts are not proven
